subject: Mutual action plan: Novisys POC environment activation & close playbook
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carolyn Miles <carolyn@novisys.com>, Ops Team <ops@novisys.com>
Cc: rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2029-03-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan: Novisys POC environment activation & close playbook

Hi Carolyn / Novisys infra team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great alignment on the core evaluation goals. Attached is a concise MAP + activation playbook focused on the POC environment items we need to hit the acceptance criteria and close the pilot: API keys & org seeding, tenant/org setup, IP allowlist, and VPC peering.

High-level asks (please confirm owners and dates):
- Org admin & contact (Novisys): confirm the primary admin account we should expect. (Due: 2029-03-22)
- API key provisioning: we can issue ephemeral seed keys or you can create a service account. Either works; need confirmation of method. (Due: 2029-03-23)
- IP allowlist: Provide CIDR(s) for your firewall to accept Redwood egress. We recommend allowing the ranges in the attached VPC template. (Due: 2029-03-23)
- VPC peering: if you want private peering, share VPC details (ASN, VPC CIDR, infra owner) so we can schedule a peering window. (Target: 2029-03-28)

Proposed close timeline: once org + keys + allowlist are in place, we propose a 3-day validation window and an acceptance call on 2029-03-29 to confirm throughput and latency SLOs.

I've attached: MAP-Novisys-POC-Checklist.xlsx (action owners + dates) and VPC-Peering-Template.pdf (what we need for peering). If procurement requires a contract or SOW prior to keys, flag the contact and I’ll loop in our finance lead.

Quick ask: can you confirm internal owners for each bullet by end of day tomorrow? I'll follow up with a short mutual-action tracker after I hear back.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0142

Attachments: MAP-Novisys-POC-Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), VPC-Peering-Template.pdf (doc)

Kim — thanks for the clear checklist. We're aligned on scope. Quick questions from infra and procurement: 

1) Does Redwood need us to create the org and service account now, or can you seed a temporary org and hand off later?
2) Are there any specific ephemeral key rotation cadence recommendations we should include in our security review?
3) Procurement asked for a short SOW/quote to attach to the internal PO. Can you send that or a link to the sandbox pricing?

I'll coordinate owners internally and reply with names for each bulleted item by EOD tomorrow. Looping in procurement so they can expedite SOW review.

—Carolyn

Carolyn — great, appreciate the quick reply. Answers inline: 

1) Org creation: either approach works. Two options:
   - You create the Novisys org and a service account for the POC (recommended if you want ownership from day one).
   - We create a temporary seeded org and transfer admin rights after acceptance (faster for a tight timeline).

Please indicate preference by 2029-03-22 so we can proceed.

2) Key rotation: for the POC we recommend ephemeral API keys with a 7- to 14-day rotation cadence; production should use short-lived keys + KMS integration. I'll attach a short security note.

3) SOW/quote: see link to the quick SOW in the tracker: https://app.redwoodinference.com/hubspot/record/HS-45217 — I'll also send a PDF to procurement if that helps.

Proposed owner slate (tentative):
- Org admin: Novisys — Carolyn (please confirm)
- API key owner: Novisys infra — Akshay
- IP allowlist owner: Novisys network — Ops Team
- VPC peering ops: Novisys infra + Redwood network eng (Jonas)

Proposed timeline (updated):
- 2029-03-22: Confirm owners + org approach
- 2029-03-23: API keys provisioned or seed keys issued
- 2029-03-23: CIDR(s) submitted for allowlist
- 2029-03-25 to 2029-03-27: Internal validation & smoke tests
- 2029-03-28: VPC peering window (if peering requested)
- 2029-03-29: Acceptance call and sign-off

I'll attach a one-page security note and our peering checklist in a follow-up email (cc-ing our security owner).

Thanks — I'll stand by for the owner confirmations.

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive

Adding a few security/ops specifics for clarity: 

- API keys: we'll provide two options in the MAP spreadsheet: (A) Seed ephemeral keys (rotate every 7 days) and hand off admin rights post-acceptance; (B) Novisys creates a service account and shares scoped keys with us. If Novisys wants scoped least-privilege keys we can provide example IAM policy snippets.

- IP allowlist: preferred Redwood egress ranges are listed in VPC-Peering-Template.pdf. For testing, allowing these CIDRs + our healthcheck 52.18.33.10 will be enough. If you need exact ranges we'll provide a /24 suggestion and a full list on request.

- VPC peering prerequisites: we need VPC CIDR, route table owner, Region, and a proposed peering window. Please ensure you have a ticket open with your cloud team for the peering creation because peering can take time depending on approvals.

Attachment: VPC-Peering-Checklist.pdf (short checklist for network teams).

If Akshay or Ops wants to run a quick connectivity dry-run (15–20 mins) before the peering window, happy to schedule.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
